item.title: Firefighters Respond to Report of Smoke in a Home
item.description: A report of smoke in a house at 217 Clay Street summoned Chillicothe Firefighters at about 2:30 pm Sunday. The crew arrived in three minutes to find smoke coming out the front door of the two-story home. They located an electric blanket smoldering on a mattress.
